product_text: Dell XPS 13 from 2020. The battery health reports 68% and dies in 35 minutes away from charger, but aluminum body and 4K screen are in mint condition.
ground_truth_rationale: Battery degradation is a standard modular consumable replacement; machine compute is fully intact.

product_text: MacBook Air 2017 with a battery that has visibly puffed up, causing the trackpad to click poorly and bulging the bottom aluminum shell.
ground_truth_rationale: Swollen lithium battery is a thermal fire hazard requiring safe containment or professional hazmat e-waste recycling.

product_text: Lenovo ThinkPad T480 fan screams at max RPM constantly, chassis gets burning hot near vents, and YouTube 1080p video stutters badly.
ground_truth_rationale: Classic thermal throttling due to dust accumulation in heatsink fins; cleaning or repasting restores performance.

product_text: HP Pavilion 15 with right display hinge cracked off plastic palmrest mount. Screen wobbles and cannot stay open on its own, but motherboard and Windows boot fine.
ground_truth_rationale: Enclosure fracture makes ideal headless desktop PC hooked to external monitor, or epoxy bracket repair.

product_text: Working 2016 Acer laptop with 8GB RAM, but Windows 10 is ending support and Microsoft says processor is unsupported for Windows 11.
ground_truth_rationale: Hardware obsolescence is artificial; installing ChromeOS Flex or Linux Mint restores modern secure browsing.

product_text: Asus ROG gaming laptop that had a glass of red wine spilled across keyboard while turned on; sparks flew and laptop is completely dead and smells burned.
ground_truth_rationale: Catastrophic liquid short-circuit across motherboard with component charring requires e-waste recovery.

product_text: Older family Toshiba satellite laptop, boots up fine but runs very slowly with a loud clicking hard drive. Otherwise all keys and screen work.
ground_truth_rationale: Clicking mechanical HDD can be replaced with a $20 SATA SSD, dramatically rejuvenating the machine.

product_text: An old laptop in a closet, unsure of the brand or model, has no charger so cannot test if it powers on.
ground_truth_rationale: Ambiguous input requires uncertainty disclosure and universal charger test before discarding.

product_text: iPhone 11 with hairline glass cracks across top corner. The OLED touch screen responds 100% and FaceID works perfectly.
ground_truth_rationale: Functional touch digitizer can be safely used with tempered glass protector overlay or screen replacement.

product_text: Samsung Galaxy S9 with a severely swollen rear cover that is pushed open 5mm with sweet chemical smell.
ground_truth_rationale: Swollen cell with chemical odor poses imminent combustion risk; mandatory hazardous e-waste.

product_text: Google Pixel 3 in mint cosmetic shape. Battery lasts all day, but banking apps no longer support Android 12 security patch level.
ground_truth_rationale: Excellent camera and sensors make prime candidate for home security cam, offline audio streamer, or dashcam.

product_text: iPad 7th gen with working display and battery, but family upgraded to newer iPad Air for school. Old iPad has no issues.
ground_truth_rationale: Fully functional modern tablet should be gifted, resold, or donated to pediatric or community center.

product_text: iPhone SE 2020 where charging cable only connects if pressed at an extreme upward angle; pocket lint visible in lightning cavity.
ground_truth_rationale: Cleaning lint with non-conductive wooden toothpick resolves intermittent charging without part replacement.

product_text: Motorola smartphone that was dropped into ocean salt water; screen is totally blank and corroded greenish around USB-C port.
ground_truth_rationale: Galvanic saltwater corrosion across SMD micro-components causes permanent logic board demise; certified e-waste.

product_text: Working Samsung phone that is iCloud/Google FRP lock stuck on activation screen because previous owner forgot password.
ground_truth_rationale: Cryptographic activation lock prevents normal OS usage; component harvest or e-waste recycling.

product_text: My phone is acting weird and battery doesn't seem right lately.
ground_truth_rationale: Vague diagnostic requires missing information inquiry regarding battery health percentage and reboot behavior.

product_text: Bose QuietComfort 35 headphones with synthetic leather cushions peeling off in black flakes, but noise canceling and audio are pristine.
ground_truth_rationale: Consumable ear cushions snap on in 2 minutes for $12, preserving premium active noise canceling headphones.

product_text: PS5 DualSense wireless controller has severe left analog stick drift, causing character to walk left automatically in all games.
ground_truth_rationale: Fast-evaporating electrical contact cleaner or potentiometer module replacement resolves drift.

product_text: Kindle Paperwhite 2018 with sharp high-contrast e-ink display. Battery only lasts 5 days instead of 4 weeks, owner bought new Kindle.
ground_truth_rationale: 5 days runtime is still superb compared to standard screens; prime candidate for resale, donation, or e-ink desk clock.

product_text: JBL Flip Bluetooth portable speaker with micro-USB port that is loose and charges only when cord is propped with a heavy book.
ground_truth_rationale: Re-soldering charging port anchor pins or swapping USB daughterboard restores portable speaker.

product_text: Audio-Technica wired studio monitor headphones where sound cuts out completely in left ear unless 3.5mm plug wire is held bent.
ground_truth_rationale: Strain-relief fatigue near 3.5mm jack is resolved by snipping wire and soldering a new $4 metal audio jack.

product_text: Amazon Echo Dot 2nd generation sitting in drawer; works fine over Wi-Fi but user stopped using Alexa voice assistant.
ground_truth_rationale: Functional smart speaker can be used as auxiliary Bluetooth receiver for vintage hi-fi or given away.

product_text: Digital wrist stopwatch with faded numbers on LCD screen; buttons press fine, has not been used in 3 years.
ground_truth_rationale: Simple $2 CR2032 coin cell battery swap restores LCD contrast.

product_text: Old electronic gadget found in garage, display doesn't light up.
ground_truth_rationale: Ambiguous electronic device requires identification and power source verification.

product_text: 100% Merino wool knit sweater with two 5mm moth holes on forearm, otherwise dense, soft, and unblemished.
ground_truth_rationale: Small wool moth holes can be easily darned or sashiko mended, preserving high-value natural animal fiber.

product_text: Patagonia down puffer jacket snagged on tree branch, causing a 2cm L-shaped rip with white goose down tufts blowing out.
ground_truth_rationale: Tenacious Tape technical nylon patch seals rip in 30 seconds without sewing punctures, restoring 100% warmth.

product_text: Levis 501 heavy denim jeans with inner thigh fabric worn thin and small 3cm crotch blowout from walking friction.
ground_truth_rationale: Iron-on fusible interfacing and machine darning across crotch extends heavy cotton denim by years.

product_text: Cheap fast-fashion 100% polyester t-shirt with heavy pilling underarms and stretched-out wavy collar.
ground_truth_rationale: Low-grade synthetic fast fashion with lost elasticity has zero secondary thrift demand; repurpose as shop rags.

product_text: Men's formal wool suit jacket and slacks, tailored 5 years ago, fits too snug around waist now but fabric is immaculate.
ground_truth_rationale: High-grade formalwear in pristine condition is prime donation for job-interview charities (Dress for Success).

product_text: Heavy canvas backpack with main zipper teeth separated and slider jammed at the top.
ground_truth_rationale: Pliers to crimp zipper slider or installing a replacement zipper slider restores canvas backpack.

product_text: Cotton button-up dress shirt with a missing third button down the placket, includes spare button sewn to inside wash tag.
ground_truth_rationale: Sewing the included spare button takes 3 minutes and needle and thread.

product_text: Bag of stained mixed old clothes from closet cleanout.
ground_truth_rationale: Ambiguous mixed clothing with unknown fabric types requires triage between rag cutting and textile drop-off.

product_text: Hardcover bestseller novel read once on vacation, pages crisp and white, spine tight, dust jacket pristine.
ground_truth_rationale: Current fiction in pristine condition is prime candidate for used book resale, peer swap, or public library donation.

product_text: Paperback book left in flooded basement for 2 months, heavily warped with black and green powdery mold colonies and pungent musty odor.
ground_truth_rationale: Active fungal mold is a health hazard; strictly prohibited from donation or circulation to protect respiratory health.

product_text: Complete 32-volume printed Encyclopedia Britannica set from 1988, bindings in good shape but information is decades out of date.
ground_truth_rationale: Public libraries reject outdated encyclopedias; upcycling into papercraft/packaging or high-grade paper pulping.

product_text: Antique 1890 poetry volume with separated cloth spine and loosened signatures, but paper is non-acid rag paper in dry condition.
ground_truth_rationale: Archival pH-neutral PVA glue and bookbinding linen cloth conserves historic collectible book.

product_text: Children's thick board book with one corner slightly chewed by teething puppy, all colorful story pages intact.
ground_truth_rationale: Cosmetic puppy chew on thick board book does not prevent continued home reading.

product_text: Some old books I found in the attic, some might be damp.
ground_truth_rationale: Ambiguous input requires checking for active mold infestation before deciding circulation vs disposal.

product_text: Solid oak dining chair with traditional mortise-and-tenon joints that wobble and squeak when sat upon. Timber is heavy and intact.
ground_truth_rationale: Scraping old glue and applying Titebond PVA wood glue with strap clamp permanently restores solid hardwood chair.

product_text: IKEA particle board bookcase where bottom cam-lock torn out completely from crumbly sawdust hole and edge swelled 2x from wet mop.
ground_truth_rationale: Reinforcing with steel corner L-brackets on underside extends utility for garage storage; otherwise bulky waste.

product_text: Mid-century solid walnut coffee table with surface water rings and shallow scratches on top varnish. Frame is rock solid.
ground_truth_rationale: Light sanding with 220 grit and Danish oil or beeswax finish restores high-value walnut timber.

product_text: Fabric armchair with sound wooden frame, but seat cushion foam is compressed flat and fabric has coffee stain.
ground_truth_rationale: Hot water extraction shampooing and inserting high-density foam core into zippered cushion restores armchair.

product_text: Heavy metal 4-drawer filing cabinet with smooth roller glides, fully functional but owner no longer has paper records.
ground_truth_rationale: Durable steel filing cabinets have high resale/donation utility for small businesses, workshops, and tool storage.

product_text: A wooden cabinet in the garage, has a loose door or something.
ground_truth_rationale: Ambiguous input requires hinge screw inspection to differentiate simple screw tightening from structural wood fracture.

product_text: KitchenAid countertop blender motor hums powerfully, but rubber clutch teeth on top of motor base are ground flat and blades don't spin.
ground_truth_rationale: The rubber drive coupler is an intentional sacrificial mechanical fuse; replacing the $4 coupler restores blender.

product_text: Stainless steel electric kettle takes 10 minutes to boil and clicks off prematurely with thick white chalky limescale on bottom plate.
ground_truth_rationale: Descaling with 50/50 white vinegar and water dissolves mineral barrier on thermostat bimetal disc, restoring operation.

product_text: Steam clothes iron with power cord insulation split wide open near handle collar, exposing bare copper strands that sparked when bent.
ground_truth_rationale: Exposed mains voltage is a critical electrocution hazard requiring qualified cord replacement or certified recycling.

product_text: Microwave oven produces scary electrical sparks and popping sounds on the right interior food cavity wall where mica sheet is charred.
ground_truth_rationale: Charred food grease on wave guide cover causes arcing; replacing the $3 interior mica sheet eliminates sparking safely.

product_text: 2-slice toaster smells like burning charcoal and smokes whenever pressed down; heating elements are continuous.
ground_truth_rationale: Dumping and brushing out the internal crumb tray removes grease fire risk and restores toaster.

product_text: Kitchen mixer acting sluggish and makes a weird noise occasionally.
ground_truth_rationale: Ambiguous input requires asking whether issue is gear lubrication, motor carbon brushes, or speed sensor.
